steps.what: Design or analyze automobile systems in these areas
Study aerodynamics, alternate fuels, ergonomics, and hybrid power
Study brakes, transmissions, steering, calibration, safety, or diagnostics

tasks.design: The engineer designs or analyzes automobile systems in areas such as aerodynamics, alternate fuels, ergonomics, hybrid power, brakes, transmissions, steering, calibration, safety, or diagnostics. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. The design stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer studies the system and decides.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the design, including where safety is involved, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not sign a design the requirement does not support.
tasks.altitude: Design and analysis stay with the engineer. Nothing in them is shortened.

reach.task: Set the requirement the design must meet
reach.learn: Which areas are safety-related on this vehicle.

evidence.claim: Designing or analyzing these automobile systems stays manual.
The engineer who signs a safety-related vehicle design remains responsible for it.

assumptions: The work starts with a system to design or analyze and ends when the engineer has judged it, or stops.
No new record is required for the judgement. Upkeep is zero.
Brakes, steering, calibration, and safety are not separated from the engineer's decision.
unknowns: Which of these areas apply to the vehicle in front of the engineer.
research_questions: Which designs did the engineer refuse because the requirement was not met?

already_counted.description: Designing or analyzing the automobile system is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the design adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every system is still designed by the engineer. High: the same design work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and present project status reports

steps.what: Prepare technical project status reports from stored milestones
Review the status reports before publication

tasks.design: The engineer prepares or presents technical or project status reports. {PROJECT} assembles the draft from stored milestones only. A blank milestone state stays blank and stops the draft. The engineer reviews the report. Only the accepted version is published. Presenting it stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer rekeyed milestone states into a report and then presented it.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored milestone states can be assembled into a draft. Publishing is a write of the accepted report.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the report is fit to present, and presenting it, stay with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer refuses a report that skips a blank milestone.
tasks.altitude: The report is published only after the engineer accepts that version. The presentation stays theirs.

reach.learn: Which milestones the lead says are mis-stated.

evidence.claim: Stored milestone states can be assembled into a status draft. The engineer reviews it before publication and still presents it.

assumptions: The work starts with a project period and ends when the accepted report is published and presented, or the engineer stops.
A milestone row has project identifier, milestone name, state, and date, entered by the engineer. A blank state is left blank and is not invented.
Publication uses the report accepted in the review. The presentation uses that same accepted report, not a later unpublished edit.
unknowns: Which milestones every project report must include.
research_questions: How often did the review stop a report because a milestone state was blank?

already_counted.description: Presenting the status reports is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a milestone state before the report is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: milestone states are often blank, so the engineer still builds the report. High: states are complete, the engineer reviews and presents, and only the accepted report is published. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct research studies in automotive engineering
Develop new concepts in that field

tasks.design: The engineer conducts research studies to develop new concepts in the field of automotive engineering. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. The study and the concept stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer reads, tests an idea, and develops the concept.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether a concept is worth pursuing stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer drops a concept the study does not support.
tasks.altitude: The research stays the engineer's. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Set the question the study must answer
reach.learn: Which concepts the lead has already closed.

evidence.claim: Research studies and new automotive concepts stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a research question and ends when the engineer has developed a concept or stopped.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A later design that uses the concept is a different task.
unknowns: Which questions the study is expected to answer.
research_questions: Which concepts did the engineer drop because the study did not support them?

already_counted.description: Conducting the research studies is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the study adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every study is still done by the engineer. High: the same research remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: The engineer establishes production or quality control standards. Nothing is published to {DOCS} by a system. Setting the standard stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer writes the standard from the process.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the standard stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not set a standard the process cannot meet.
tasks.altitude: The standard stays the engineer's decision. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Say what the line can hold
reach.learn: Which limits the line already misses.

evidence.claim: Establishing production or quality control standards stays manual.
The engineer who sets a standard for a safety-related process remains responsible for that standard.

assumptions: The work starts with a process that needs a standard and ends when the engineer has set it, or stops.
No new record is filed by a system. Upkeep is zero.
Applying the standard on the line is a different task.
unknowns: Which standards must be signed before the line may use them.
research_questions: Which standards did the engineer refuse because the line could not meet them?

already_counted.description: Establishing production standards is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: setting the standard adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every standard is still set by the engineer. High: the same judgement remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer still tests, calibrates, and signs the design. A report, estimate, procedure, or document is written or published only after the engineer accepts that version.
reach: A project lead receives only a status report the engineer has accepted.
A production colleague receives only a procedure the engineer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required figure, milestone, or price is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep testing, calibration, and design decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every status report traces to a stored milestone, and the engineer still signs the exception.
